evidence.method: agent-prepared: pin numbers/names and pad multiset diffed against the installed KiCad 10.0.6 symbol and footprint files; no datasheet read
evidence.notes: Scope: pin numbers and pad multiset only. lead_d_mm 0.5 = typical radial electrolytic lead (0.5 for D<=8 mm); KiCad drill 0.8. Polarity: KiCad CP footprint pad 1 = '+' (roundrect pad, KiCad CP convention; the footprint has no '+' text, convention verified from the library file: pad 1 roundrect, pad 2 circle).

polarity.pin1: + (positive, longer lead); body stripe marks the negative lead

notes: ILLUSTRATIVE: lead size is the family-typical value, not read from a part datasheet. POLARISED electrolytic (blinky C1 10uF, reflex C2/C6 220uF). Bound to Device:C_Polarized since P1-T9b (pin 1 = +, same pad numbers as Device:C), so the schematic shows which pin is +. Pin 1 = +, pin 2 = - in the netlists.
